Based on my analysis of all modules in `profiling_sandbox/click/`, here's a concise inventory of what each module provides that the others do not:

| Module | Unique State/Functionality | File:Line |
|--------|---------------------------|-----------|
| **core.py** | Core command classes (Command, Group, Option, Argument, Context, Parameter, ParameterSource) and base CLI infrastructure | core.py:1 |
| **decorators.py** | High-level decorator functions (argument, option, group, command, pass_context, pass_obj, make_pass_decorator, version_option, help_option, confirmation_option, password_option, custom_version_option) | decorators.py:1 |
| **exceptions.py** | All exception classes (ClickException, UsageError, BadParameter, BadOptionUsage, BadArgumentUsage, NoSuchOption, NoSuchCommand, MissingParameter, FileError, Abort) | exceptions.py:1 |
| **formatting.py** | HelpFormatter class and wrap_text() utility for text wrapping and help formatting | formatting.py:1 |
| **globals.py** | get_current_context() function for accessing the current Click context | globals.py:1 |
| **parser.py** | Internal _OptionParser class (deprecated) and argument/option parsing utilities (split_opt, normalize_opt, _unpack_args) | parser.py:1 |
| **termui.py** | Terminal UI functions (prompt, confirm, getchar, pause, progressbar, secho, style, unstyle, echo_via_pager, clear, edit, launch, get_pager_file) | termui.py:1 |
| **types.py** | Parameter type classes (ParamType, Choice, Path, File, IntRange, FloatRange, DateTime, UUID, Tuple, BOOL, STRING, FLOAT, UNPROCESSED) | types.py:1 |
| **utils.py** | Utility functions (echo, format_filename, get_app_dir, open_file, _get_binary_stream, _get_text_stream) | utils.py:1 |
| **_compat.py** | Cross-platform compatibility utilities (CYGWIN/WIN detection, _make_text_stream, _NonClosingTextIOWrapper, _is_ascii, _default_text_width, _get_windows_console) | _compat.py:1 |
| **_winconsole.py** | Windows-specific console handling (get_windows_console, _get_wide_console, _get_wide_console_size) | _winconsole.py:1 |
| **_textwrap.py** | Custom
